podcast.body: Co-written by Iggy Pop and David Bowie, this song was originally released on Iggy's 1977 album The Idiot. David Bowie later had a major hit with his own recording of the song in the early 1980s, which earned Iggy Pop close to a million dollars. "China Girl from 1977. A song co-written by David Bowie who of course had a big hit with his own recording of that song in the early 1980s."

podcast.body: This song is an original track from Iggy Pop's first solo album, *The Idiot*. David Bowie later covered it, and the royalties from Bowie's version provided crucial financial support to Iggy Pop during a difficult economic period. "China Girl originariamente es una canción del primer disco de Iguipop en solitario."
